text.offer: Merchants are refusing to use the East Merchant Way and the Flatlands - spiders, big ones, dropping on the carts. Cor Noth lives on that trade. Kill fifteen of them and the merchants will have no more excuses.
text.progress: The East Merchant Way and the Flatlands are south and east of Cor Noth.
text.complete: The merchants are already back on the road. Good work.
